events.content:
The project route now resolves the cached title before rendering a Suspense boundary around the details. Next’s default Link prefetch can include the title in the route shell; the details load separately after navigation and are no longer cached as part of that shell.

I didn’t run tests. The existing changes in `package.json` and the untracked `package-lock.json` were left untouched.
